options.code: const rows=queries.requests.data||[];const today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);const pending=rows.filter(r=>['Manager review','Security review'].includes(r.status));return {pending:pending.length,overdue:pending.filter(r=>r.due_on<today).length,ready:rows.filter(r=>r.status==='Approved').length,active:rows.filter(r=>r.status==='Active').length,expiring:rows.filter(r=>r.status==='Active'&&r.expires_on<=new Date(Date.now()+7*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10)).length,chart:['Finance','Engineering','People operations','Revenue operations','Design','Data platform'].map(x=>({x,y:pending.filter(r=>r.department===x).length}))};
